Smart automation handles routine questions, freeing the team to resolve complex issues and recommend products customers will love.When integrating an eCommerce support platformIf your eCommerce business is handling an increasing volume of customer inquiries, especially across different channels, it may be time to integrate customer support software. Managing all these interactions manually can slow response times, reduce customer satisfaction, and strain your team. Tracking essential metrics such as resolution times and customer satisfaction becomes much easier, providing insights to improve service continuously.
